title: The RSA cryptographic key material, including a private key and public key, is embedded within the… (CVE-2026-124599)
description: This vulnerability involves RSA cryptographic key material, including private and public keys, embedded directly within an Android application package. Because Android apps can be extracted and reverse engineered, an attacker could recover these keys. This may allow impersonation of the application or unauthorized cryptographic operations. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 6.2.
